title: Putting an end to bullying and school violence (SOP33)

sentences.en: Cyberbullying and violence can be a persistent problem for kids of all ages, in schools, and even at home.
sentences.zh: 网络欺凌和暴力对于各年龄段的孩子来说，无论是在学校还是在家里，都可能是一个长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: One out of three students is bullied during the school year, according to the National Center for Educational Statistics.
sentences.zh: 根据国家教育统计中心的数据，每三个学生中就有一个在学年中遭受过欺凌。

sentences.en: It's a problem that is dramatically affecting the mental health of young people in a variety of ways.
sentences.zh: 这个问题正以多种方式严重影响着年轻人的心理健康。

sentences.en: In this episode, we speak with one psychologist about why school-wide anti-bullying and anti-violence programs are so important.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们采访了一位心理学家，探讨为什么全校范围的反欺凌和反暴力项目如此重要。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学谈话》。

sentences.en: Dorothy Espelage is a professor of educational psychology at the University of Illinois, Urbana-Champaign.
sentences.zh: 多萝西·埃斯佩拉格是伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的教育心理学教授。

sentences.en: She has been conducting research on bullying, sexual harassment, dating violence, and gang violence for the last 20 years.
sentences.zh: 过去20年来，她一直致力于欺凌、性骚扰、约会暴力和帮派暴力方面的研究。

sentences.en: She is associate editor of the Journal of Counseling Psychology and is author of more than 120 peer-reviewed journal articles.
sentences.zh: 她是《咨询心理学杂志》的副主编，也是120多篇同行评审期刊文章的作者。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Espelage.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，埃斯佩拉格博士。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: The psychological study of bullies and bullying has come a long way.
sentences.zh: 对欺凌者和欺凌行为的心理学研究已经取得了长足的进步。

sentences.en: I think there's been a lot more awareness of the issue and what it means for children's mental health.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对这一问题及其对儿童心理健康的影响有了更多的认识。

sentences.en: Has all this awareness made a difference from what you've seen in the research in the prevalence of bullying and aggression in schools?
sentences.zh: 根据您的研究，所有这些认识是否在学校欺凌和攻击行为的普遍性方面带来了改变？

sentences.en: Certainly there has been a heightened awareness.
sentences.zh: 当然，人们的意识确实提高了。

sentences.en: We have studied it for a number of decades, but it wasn't until 2011, when President Obama had his White House conference on bullying,
sentences.zh: 我们研究这个问题已经几十年了，但直到2011年奥巴马总统召开白宫欺凌问题会议之后，

sentences.en: that really the public took notice of bullying.
sentences.zh: 公众才真正开始关注欺凌问题。

sentences.en: It's difficult to estimate whether or not this awareness has contributed to a decrease in the prevalence of it,
sentences.zh: 很难估计这种意识是否促成了欺凌现象的减少，

sentences.en: but certainly we do know from national statistics that in some schools where there's lower violence, we've seen less bullying.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实从国家统计数据中了解到，在一些暴力程度较低的学校，我们看到的欺凌现象也较少。

sentences.en: But certainly in our studies, and we're engaged in studies in hundreds of schools right now, it's still alive and well in our schools, and we need to be concerned about it,
sentences.zh: 但在我们的研究中——我们目前正在数百所学校进行研究——欺凌现象在学校里依然存在，我们必须对此保持警惕，

sentences.en: and it's a difficult behavior to decrease.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一种很难减少的行为。

sentences.en: What do we know about what predicts involvement in bullying and aggression?
sentences.zh: 关于预测欺凌和攻击行为的参与因素，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: You hear video games, other types of media.
sentences.zh: 你会听到人们提到电子游戏或其他类型的媒体。

sentences.en: How much do we know about what causes it?
sentences.zh: 我们对它的成因了解多少？

sentences.en: Yeah, we know that actually predicting who's going to be involved as someone that is what we call a perpetrator or a target is very, very complex.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们知道预测谁会成为所谓的“施暴者”或“受害者”是非常、非常复杂的。

sentences.en: And so it just really depends on their home environment.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于他们的家庭环境。

sentences.en: It depends on a child's school, whether or not they have anti-bullying policies in place.
sentences.zh: 这取决于孩子的学校是否制定了反欺凌政策。

sentences.en: It's whether or not they're in middle school.
sentences.zh: 也取决于他们是否处于初中阶段。

sentences.en: In middle school, bullying tends to be concentrated among some of the most popular kids.
sentences.zh: 在初中，欺凌往往集中在一些最受欢迎的孩子中间。

sentences.en: When kids are younger, they seem to kind of navigate this, and kids that engage in bullying behaviors are rejected.
sentences.zh: 当孩子还小的时候，他们似乎能处理好这些关系，而参与欺凌行为的孩子会被排斥。

sentences.en: But by middle school, they really do have high social status.
sentences.zh: 但到了初中，这些孩子确实拥有很高的社会地位。

sentences.en: By high school, it really nuances into sexual harassment and teen dating violence.
sentences.zh: 到了高中，它就演变成了性骚扰和青少年约会暴力。

sentences.en: So I think what we do know is that there's not a deterministic model.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们所知道的是，并没有一个决定论的模型。

sentences.en: We can't predict who's going to be involved in bullying as a perpetrator or a victim.
sentences.zh: 我们无法预测谁会作为施暴者或受害者参与到欺凌中。

sentences.en: But we certainly do know that there are certain risk factors, and that could be violence in the home.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道存在某些风险因素，比如家庭暴力。

sentences.en: It could be neighborhoods in which they're witnessing violence.
sentences.zh: 也可能是他们目睹了社区中的暴力行为。

sentences.en: It could be that you have a sibling that is aggressive towards you, and then you play that behavior out in school.
sentences.zh: 也可能是因为有兄弟姐妹对你表现出攻击性，然后你在学校里重演了这种行为。

sentences.en: We also know that school climate matters.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道学校氛围很重要。

sentences.en: So if I'm in a school in which there's no anti-bullying policies and the teachers model violence or they actually bully themselves, then the kids are more likely to bully.
sentences.zh: 如果我所在的学校没有反欺凌政策，老师们表现出暴力倾向，或者他们自己就参与欺凌，那么孩子们就更有可能去欺凌别人。

sentences.en: But if I'm in a school in which it's not tolerated, then I'm less likely to engage in that behavior.
sentences.zh: 但如果我所在的学校不容忍这种行为，那么我参与这种行为的可能性就会降低。

sentences.en: And so certainly we know that there might be individual characteristics that predict whether or not I'm going to engage in these behaviors.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当然知道，可能存在一些个人特征可以预测我是否会参与这些行为。

sentences.en: But it's not deterministic.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是决定性的。

sentences.en: It depends on the larger social environment.
sentences.zh: 它取决于更广泛的社会环境。

sentences.en: And a lot of your research does focus on the schools and their role in bullying and aggression.
sentences.zh: 您的很多研究确实集中在学校及其在欺凌和攻击行为中的角色上。

sentences.en: What role do schools play in bullying, and how can they prevent it from becoming a widespread problem?
sentences.zh: 学校在欺凌问题中扮演什么角色？他们如何防止其成为普遍问题？

sentences.en: You can go into more detail on that.
sentences.zh: 您可以详细说明一下吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, certainly.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: I mean, kids spend more time in schools than they do sometimes even with their parents or in their neighborhoods or in their homes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，孩子们在学校待的时间有时甚至比和父母在一起、在社区或家里待的时间还要长。

sentences.en: So the school is pivotal.
sentences.zh: 所以学校至关重要。

sentences.en: Now, the school is not the only place where we need to intervene, but certainly we do know from our research that if we implement what we call social-emotional learning programs,
sentences.zh: 学校并不是我们唯一需要干预的地方，但我们的研究确实表明，如果我们实施所谓的“社会情感学习项目”，

sentences.en: where we teach kids empathy and perspective-taking, how to communicate, how to problem-solve, how to resolve conflicts, we have less bullying, we have less sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 即教导孩子同理心、换位思考、如何沟通、如何解决问题、如何化解冲突，我们就能减少欺凌和性骚扰。

sentences.en: And so certainly schools do play a role.
sentences.zh: 所以学校确实发挥着作用。

sentences.en: We also know that a lot of people talk about, oh, the epidemic is cyberbullying.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道很多人在谈论“网络欺凌”这种流行病。

sentences.en: The bottom line is that most of the conflicts that play out through media and through the Internet actually start at school.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，大多数通过媒体和互联网表现出来的冲突，实际上都是从学校开始的。

sentences.en: So the schools play a pivotal role in creating a positive school climate so that when kids do pick up technology, they're less likely to be mean and cruel.
sentences.zh: 因此，学校在营造积极的校园氛围方面起着关键作用，这样当孩子们接触科技产品时，他们就不太可能表现得刻薄和残忍。

sentences.en: Another area of research that you're focusing on now is sexual harassment and teen dating violence.
sentences.zh: 您现在关注的另一个研究领域是性骚扰和青少年约会暴力。

sentences.en: How serious is this problem among middle and high school students specifically?
sentences.zh: 这个问题在初中生和高中生中到底有多严重？

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: and I mean it's hard for anybody listening to this to think that a 6th grader who's 10 years old would engage in any type of inappropriate sexual commentary or rumor spreading.
sentences.zh: 对于任何听众来说，很难想象一个10岁的六年级学生会进行任何形式的不当性评论或散布谣言。

sentences.en: But we do know that about 30% of 6th through 8th graders engage in unwanted sexual commentary and sexual rumor spreading.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实知道，大约30%的六至八年级学生参与过不当的性评论和散布性谣言。

sentences.en: Luckily, only 1 to 3% of 6th through 8th graders report being inappropriately touched, but we do know that that number goes up quite substantially in high school.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，只有1%到3%的六至八年级学生报告说被不当触摸，但我们知道这个数字在高中阶段会大幅上升。

sentences.en: And the bottom line is if we do not – high school is too late to start talking about sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果我们不——等到高中才开始谈论性骚扰已经太晚了。

sentences.en: And we're in the United States and sexual harassment is illegal in K through 12 just as it is in workplaces.
sentences.zh: 我们身处美国，在幼儿园到高中的学校里，性骚扰和在工作场所一样都是违法的。

sentences.en: And so we need to start talking to kids about the sexual commentary that they use so that it doesn't escalate to the unwanted sexual harassment that is quite prevalent in high school.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要开始和孩子们谈论他们使用的性评论，以免其升级为高中里相当普遍的不当性骚扰。

sentences.en: You mentioned before that schools aren't the only places where all of this needs to be happened.
sentences.zh: 您之前提到学校并不是唯一需要解决这些问题的地方。

sentences.en: But can you give them some examples of other areas that needs to improve that?
sentences.zh: 您能举一些其他需要改进的领域的例子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, so certainly.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然可以。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that schools are pivotal, but the reality is that kids reside in other contexts, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为学校至关重要，但现实是孩子们还生活在其他环境中，对吧？

sentences.en: So we have to think about even boys and girls clubs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须考虑到青少年俱乐部。

sentences.en: We have to think about sports, right?
sentences.zh: 我们必须考虑到体育运动，对吧？

sentences.en: So only now are coaches starting to think like, okay, maybe I play a role in the escalation of bullying or sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 所以现在教练们才开始思考：好吧，也许我在欺凌或性骚扰的升级中扮演了某种角色。

sentences.en: In the home, parents need to have open dialogues with their youth about what they're doing online, who they're engaging with.
sentences.zh: 在家里，父母需要与孩子进行开放式的对话，了解他们在网上做什么，以及他们与谁互动。

sentences.en: If parents are listening now, talk to their kids about sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 如果现在有家长在听，请和你们的孩子谈谈性骚扰。

sentences.en: Talk to them about bullying.
sentences.zh: 和他们谈谈欺凌。

sentences.en: Are they those good kids that just go along with that kind of bully ringleader?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种只会盲目跟随欺凌带头人的“好孩子”吗？

sentences.en: All of us need to have this conversation.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都需要进行这种对话。

sentences.en: It should happen in churches.
sentences.zh: 这应该在教堂里进行。

sentences.en: It should happen anywhere that you have a child and you interact with a child.
sentences.zh: 这应该在任何有孩子、有互动的地方进行。

sentences.en: These conversations need to happen.
sentences.zh: 这些对话必须发生。

sentences.en: I think parents also have this idea that the schools have to do something about the bullying.
sentences.zh: 我认为家长们也有一种想法，认为学校必须对欺凌行为负责。

sentences.en: You hear that a lot, and I'm a parent, so I know even in elementary school you say, well, this needs to be handled.
sentences.zh: 你经常听到这种说法，我也是一位家长，所以我知道即使在小学，你也会说，这需要被处理。

sentences.en: I mean, what is the best way to go about getting the school to intervene or having the parent involved?
sentences.zh: 那么，让学校介入或让家长参与的最佳方式是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what sort of level of coordination do you need there?
sentences.zh: 你们需要什么样的协调水平？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I think that we know from, you know, systematic studies that if we address the issue of bullying and sexual harassment and teen dating violence from all directions,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为从系统性的研究中我们知道，如果我们从各个方向解决欺凌、性骚扰和青少年约会暴力问题，

sentences.en: in the home and in the school.
sentences.zh: 即在家里和学校同时进行。

sentences.en: But the reality is kids spend a lot of time in the schools, and schools are mandated.
sentences.zh: 但现实是孩子们在学校花了很多时间，而且学校是有强制性要求的。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, there are laws.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，法律是存在的。

sentences.en: I mean, there are unfunded mandates, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些是无资金支持的强制性任务，对吧？

sentences.en: So schools are told you will address the bullying problem, but we're not going to give you any funds to do this.
sentences.zh: 所以学校被告知你们必须解决欺凌问题，但我们不会给你们任何资金来做这件事。

sentences.en: And your teachers are overworked, and the teachers feel that they have to address bullying and put that on their plate,
sentences.zh: 而且你们的老师已经不堪重负，他们觉得必须解决欺凌问题，这增加了他们的负担，

sentences.en: along with other things that they have to address in the social ills.
sentences.zh: 还要处理其他社会弊病。

sentences.en: The reality is, is that in our research, we find that if, in fact, schools are addressing it and teachers feel supported by their administration to address the bullying problem,
sentences.zh: 现实情况是，我们的研究发现，如果学校确实在解决这个问题，并且老师感到得到了管理层的支持来处理欺凌问题，

sentences.en: they feel that they can dialogue with the parents.
sentences.zh: 他们就会觉得可以与家长进行对话。

sentences.en: There's less bullying.
sentences.zh: 欺凌现象就会减少。

sentences.en: So, again, it's not just that there's a quick fix.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并不是说有一个快速的解决方案。

sentences.en: There's not a quick fix.
sentences.zh: 没有快速的解决方案。

sentences.en: We know that if it's a positive school climate and kids like going to school and they're connected with their teachers, there's less bullying.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，如果学校氛围积极，孩子们喜欢上学，并且与老师建立了联系，欺凌现象就会减少。

sentences.en: And so that's just one area where we can address it, but certainly we can't do it without the parents.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是我们可以解决的一个方面，但如果没有家长的参与，我们肯定做不到。

sentences.en: We actually know that kids that are, when they're bullied online, 85% of the time, they're at home.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上知道，85%的被网络欺凌的孩子是在家里遭受欺凌的。

sentences.en: And so when I talk to parents, like, I need, parents need to engage with the schools.
sentences.zh: 所以当我与家长交谈时，我会说，家长需要与学校互动。

sentences.en: There needs to be an open form of communication.
sentences.zh: 需要有一种开放的沟通形式。

sentences.en: We can't do it alone.
sentences.zh: 我们无法独自完成。

sentences.en: All of us need to get on the same page.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都需要达成共识。

sentences.en: Thank you, Dr. Espelage.
sentences.zh: 谢谢您，埃斯佩拉格博士。

sentences.en: It's been very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 感谢您参加我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: For more information on Dr. Espelage's work and to hear more episodes, please go to our website, speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多关于埃斯佩拉格博士工作的信息并收听更多剧集，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Audrey Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 这里是美国心理学会的《心理学谈话》，我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿。
